title: Strata Protocol Wire Schema
description: Single source of truth for Strata JSON-RPC 2.0 constants, methods, events, error codes, and wire DTOs.

ServiceRestartPolicy.description: Automatic restart policy for a managed container background service.

ServiceStatus.description: Runtime lifecycle status of a managed container background service.

DistroMirror.description: Online Simplestreams ARM64 distro catalog mirror selection.

ContainerJobKind.description: Kind of asynchronous container provisioning or storage job.

ContainerJobState.description: Execution state of an asynchronous container provisioning job.

CapProfile.description: Container Linux capability policy derived from configuration or debug override.

ContainerPhase.description: Observable lifecycle phase for a managed container.

SessionMode.description: Execution mode for an interactive CLI attach lease.

TaskStream.description: Output stream label for task.output events.

WebConsoleConfig.description: Embedded HTTP/WebSocket PC Console control-plane settings.

SideVeilBridgeConfig.description: Optional SideVeil uds-native plugin bridge configuration.

SshConfig.description: Dropbear SSH listener settings for a container.

ContainerServiceSpec.description: Declarative configuration for a supervised background service inside a container.

ContainerConfig.description: Per-container runtime, storage, isolation, and networking specification.

AttachLease.description: Lease granted by stratad to strata CLI for local setns or stage2 sessions.

ContainerDiskStats.description: Disk allocation and rootfs utilization snapshot.

ContainerStatusSnapshot.description: Complete status snapshot for one container.

DaemonSummarySnapshot.description: Compact daemon summary for daemon.status and Native HUD.

StorageCleanupReport.description: Verification counters returned after stopping or tearing down a container.

MaintenanceDonePayload.description: Asynchronous completion event for long-running maintenance operations.

ContainerSelectorParams.description: Shared selector parameter targeting an explicit or default container.

TaskSummary.description: Summary descriptor returned by task.list and task.logs.

TaskOutputPayload.description: Payload pushed with task.output events and returned by task.logs.

HudStateResult.description: Result returned by hud.state and hud.set.

KernelCapabilitiesResult.description: Live kernel container capability probe returned by daemon.capabilities.

WebStatusResult.description: Runtime status of the embedded HTTP/WebSocket PC Console server.

DistroEntry.description: Single ARM64 rootfs image entry from a Simplestreams catalog.

ContainerJobStartResult.description: Result returned immediately when an async container provisioning job is accepted.

ContainerJobProgressPayload.description: Progress snapshot emitted with container.job.progress and returned by container.jobStatus.

ContainerServiceRuntime.description: Live runtime status for a supervised background service inside a container.

ServiceSelectorParams.description: Parameters selecting one supervised service inside a container.

ServiceStateChangedPayload.description: Event payload emitted on service.stateChanged transitions.
